hints.title: Track Chef Availability
hints.text: Maintain a variable representing the earliest time the chef becomes idle.

hints.title: Compute Customer Completion
hints.text: The cooking starts at max(current idle time, arrival time) and finishes after the order duration.

hints.title: Accumulate Wait Times
hints.text: The wait time is completion time minus arrival time. Sum across all customers and divide by total customers.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating every discrete second takes O(total_time) which is too slow when times reach 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Event-driven simulation advances idle time directly in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should simulate chef availability sequentially with 64-bit integer accumulators.
